features.name: Dual Mind
features.description: You have advantage on all Wisdom saving throws.

features.name: Mental Discipline
features.description: You have resistance to psychic damage. If you would gain psychic resistance from another source, you instead gain advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

features.name: Mind Link
features.description: As a bonus action, you can telepathically send a brief message (a single word or short phrase) to a creature you can see within 30 feet. The creature hears the message in your voice. You can use this bonus action a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Naptime Remedy
features.description: Grant allies visions of peace to help revitalize your wounded allies during a short rest. If you or any friendly creatures regain hit points at the end of the short rest by spending one or more Hit Dice, each of those creatures regains an extra 1d6 hit points. These hit points increase to 1d8 at 5th level, 1d10 at 11th level, and 1d12 at 17th level.
